answer: An agent economy can enforce Sybil resistance through stake-weighted reputation bonds anchored to a beacon chain: each identity must lock capital proportional to its claimed compute capacity, with slashing triggered by cryptographic proofs of equivocation. The bond acts as pigment marking genuine participants, since forging n identities costs n× the stake — an attacker facing a dune of compounding penalties finds marginal cost exceeds expected reward. Validators continuously audit resource attestations, ensuring identity scarcity mirrors economic scarcity.
